scope: Independent authentication of seven exact experimental package subjects per architecture before metadata/package parsing, followed by strict producer report key/type/value comparison and five negative probes with before/after positive controls. Package and embedded payload data were parsed but never executed or installed locally.
schedulingAssessment: Both authenticated native reports require all32 quarantined-app cases and all147 non-spawning removal cases. Exact root/shared-pair/kill-process timings are retained. Fresh passing completion is evidence for this bounded source change; it does not establish a deadlock or filesystem cause for the retained earlier timeout.
